template:
You are validating an upstream alert from an automatic change detector on a fixed CCTV camera.
Upstream alert: {category} at the spot shown in this clip, confidence 0.60. The alert does not say more; the clip may be a magnified crop of the spot.
Validate the alert: confirm it only if the clip clearly shows one of these right-of-way incidents, otherwise discard it.

CATEGORIES:
- PERSON_ON_TRACKS: a person on railway tracks, not on a platform.
- COLLISION: a vehicle hits another vehicle, a person, a barrier or an object, or spins out of control.
- STALLED_VEHICLE: a vehicle stopped or broken down in a traffic lane. Not a vehicle parked at a kerb or queued behind others.
- OBSTRUCTION: an object left lying across a pavement, path or road so that people or vehicles cannot pass. Not someone painting, breaking or forcing something.
- DAMAGE: property damaged or defaced: graffiti being painted, glass broken, a surface cut or burnt. Choose this even if the damaged thing is next to a path.
- TAMPERING: someone forcing, cutting or picking a lock, gate or door.
- NONE: none of these: ordinary traffic, people walking, parked vehicles, a stationary train.

Reply with JSON only, no other text:
{"decision": "<confirm or discard>", "category": "<the category when confirm; NONE when discard>", "confidence": <0.0 to 1.0>, "reason": "<one sentence on what the frames show, in the order it happens>", "evidence_frames": "<start, middle or end of the clip>", "object": "<the main object or person involved, at most four words>", "still_present": <true or false>}
